module: Flowgraph node "Decal Single" (category repeat_instant, util/draw). Draws a single decal in the world. Input pins: pos, rot (quat), scl, decalPath (parkDecalStripes.png by default), clrA, clrB (colors, ping-pong alternation) and clrFrequency (2).
notes: The color oscillates between clrA and clrB according to os.clockhp() * clrFrequency.
work reads pinIn.clrA.value[i] without a check: crashes if the colors are nil (they have a hardcoded default value).

work.desc: Computes the color, builds the decal and sends it to Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals.
